bio_html: Md. Ehsanul Haque Chowdhury is a Masters student in Applied Statistics and Data Science at the Institute of Applied Statistics and Data Science (formerly known as Institute of Statistical Research and Training), University of Dhaka. His research interests include mental health, public health, reproductive health, psychometrics, healthcare informatics, and applied statistical analysis. He has contributed to systematic reviews and meta-analysis, survey data analysis, scale validation, exploratory factor analysis, and health application development. His technical experience includes R, RMarkdown, Stata, SPSS, LaTeX, tidyverse, and ggplot2. He also serves as Program Head at Positive Plus Foundation.
